limits: No real GPU device, browser, Electron GUI, pixel-fidelity, VRAM or FPS acceptance was run.
Default Vitest excludes historical .mjs scripts and the selected Node matrix is not every historical Node/Bun test.
The prior export-ownership.test.mjs source-extractor failure remains known and outside this final matrix; it is not fixed or counted as passed.
Private-fixture skips/trivial returns retain their prior caveats; inspect the current detailed assertion report for skipped test identity.
CPU recording-driver contracts and initialized WASM tests do not reproduce or certify the user’s original Electron document or 3200% GPU behavior.
Native Rust pointwise tests are reported separately from frontend tests and are not added into a whole-product acceptance count.
